# Formula-Derived Variables Implementation Plan (#39, Phase A)

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Variables carrying a `mockFormula` expression are generated by evaluating that expression over already-generated columns — in dependency order, in a restricted sandbox — so mock data can exercise derived-variable pipelines. Algebraic formulas only (Phase A); `Func::` dispatch stays excluded.

**Architecture:** A third pipeline stage. `generate_mock_data_native()` skips `type = "formula"` variables; a new exported `evaluate_mock_formulas(data, spec, seed = NULL)` computes them post-baseline (topologically ordered among themselves, evaluated in an environment exposing only generated columns + a fixed base-function allow-list, under `.with_mock_seed(stage = "formula")`); `postprocess_mock_data()` then applies missing codes/garbage to all columns including derived ones. Orchestrator order: baseline → formulas → postprocess. Formulas are computed on *clean* baseline values (before contamination), then may receive their own missing codes/garbage — and postprocess's existing missing-column check makes running the stages out of order fail loudly.

**Tech Stack:** base R (`str2lang`, `all.vars`, `all.names`, `eval` with restricted environments — no new dependency), testthat edition 3, roxygen2.

**Decision source:** [development/adr/v05-formula-evaluator.md](../adr/v05-formula-evaluator.md) (ACCEPTED 2026-07-07): D1(a) `mockFormula` column on `variable_details`; D2(a) post-baseline stage; D3 restricted sandbox + ratified allow-list; D4 Phase A only; D5 diagnostics marking; D6 `mockFormula` ⇒ generated, bare `DerivedVar::`/`Func::` ⇒ still excluded.

**Base:** branch `v05-seed-contract` head `0f9bda8` (#38 provides `.with_mock_seed(stage=)` and `.MOCK_STAGES["formula"]`). If PR #48 has merged, branch `v05-formula-evaluator` off `dev` instead — verify `.MOCK_STAGES` exists before starting.

## Global Constraints

Inherited from `development/post-v040-development-plan.md` Global Constraints (commit style, fixtures via `system.file()`+skip, CI locale, no check artefacts, review before push). Plus:

- **Zero seeded-output change for existing specs.** This feature is additive; specs without formula variables must produce byte-identical output. Enforced mechanically by #48's pins in `tests/testthat/test-seed-contract.R`: the frozen `.MOCK_STAGES` equality test and the baseline/postprocess pinned values. If any of those fail during this work, the change is wrong — fix the code, never the pins.
- **Formula variables draw exclusively from the `formula` sub-stream** (`.MOCK_STAGES["formula"]`, index 2 — already reserved). Note: the Phase A allow-list contains no RNG functions, so Phase A formulas are deterministic; the sub-stream wrap is structural (future-proofing), not load-bearing yet.
- **Sandbox is closed:** evaluation must not reach the caller's frame, globalenv, or any function outside the allow-list. `enclos = parent.frame()` (the spike's approach) is prohibited.
- **recodeflow semantics untouched:** `DerivedVar::`/`Func::` meaning unchanged; `mockFormula` is a MockData-extension column; metadata without it behaves identically to today (regression-tested).
- Test suite baseline at plan date: FAIL 0 | WARN 35 | SKIP 11 | PASS 699. Do not exceed WARN/SKIP with new noise.

## Evidence base (verified 2026-07-16 at `0f9bda8`)

- Spike machinery to recover: `git show f4f9b41:development/v04-simstudy-spike/prototype.R` — `formula_dependencies()` (`all.vars(str2lang(...))`), `order_spec_by_dependencies()` (progress-loop topological sort; cycle message "Formula dependency cycle or unresolved ordering among: ..."), `validate_formula_referents()`. Its eval (`enclos = parent.frame()`) is NOT recovered — replaced by the D3 sandbox.
- Spec fields `formula` / `depends_on` already exist on `.new_mock_spec_variable()` (`R/mock_spec.R:101,106`), unused.
- Per-variable validator branches on type at `R/mock_spec.R:815/834/852`, else **errors "unsupported type"** at `:855` — a `formula` branch is mandatory or construction-time validation rejects formula specs.
- v0.4 supported-check **already flags any formula-carrying variable as unsupported** (`R/create_mock_data.R:12-18`) → legacy fallback. Task 3 inverts this for `type == "formula"` (and keeps flagging a stray `formula` on a *non*-formula variable).
- Orchestrator pipeline seam: `R/create_mock_data.R:98-102` (`baseline <- generate_mock_data_native(...)` then `postprocess_mock_data(...)`).
- Native dispatch `.generate_native_variable()` at `R/mock_spec_native.R:314-323`; generation loop `columns <- lapply(spec$variables, .generate_native_variable, n = n)` at `:383` — formula vars must be filtered out before this lapply.
- `postprocess_mock_data()` missing-column check (`setdiff(names(spec$variables), names(data))`) means skipping the formula stage fails loudly. `.postprocess_variable()` dispatches on `type == "categorical" || rtype == "integer"` (`R/mock_spec_postprocess.R:154`) — formula variables carry a concrete `rtype`, so missing-code/garbage handling keys off rtype as usual; Task 3 verifies with a test.
- Adapter: `mock_spec_from_recodeflow(..., exclude_derived = TRUE)` excludes `identify_derived_vars()` hits at `R/mock_spec_recodeflow.R:471-472`; kind resolution `.recodeflow_variable_kind(var_row)` at `:117`; per-variable construction `.recodeflow_to_spec_variable(var_row, details, databaseStart)` at `:306`; column access pattern `.row_character(row, col, default)`.
- Docs that will be stale the moment this merges (Task 4): `vignettes/design-philosophy-v04.qmd` "What is deliberately deferred" (formula variables listed as deferred); `vignettes/migrating-from-v03-v04.qmd` fallback-conditions section (names formula variables as a legacy-fallback trigger).

### Decisions carried from the ADR, resolved here

- **Direct API:** a dedicated `mock_formula()` constructor (+ `mock_spec_formula()` composable form), not a `formula=` argument on existing constructors — formula variables have no `range`/`levels`/`distribution`, so overloading the other constructors would create nonsense parameter combinations.
- **Diagnostics fields (D5):** `derived = TRUE`, `formula` (string), `depends_on` (character vector) on the variable's `mockdata_diagnostics` entry.
- **`mockFormula` read semantics:** first non-blank `mockFormula` among the variable's `variable_details` rows (a variable's details may span multiple rows; the formula is a variable-level fact stored row-level per ADR).
- **Allow-list:** the ADR's ratified set **plus `c`** (required by `cut(breaks = c(...))`; the ADR authorizes widening on concrete need).

### Task map

```
Task 1: spec layer  — constructor, validator branch, allow-list, deps/order/referent checks
Task 2: evaluator   — evaluate_mock_formulas(); native backend skips formula vars
Task 3: wiring      — adapter mockFormula + D6 carve-out; orchestrator stage; diagnostics; e2e
Task 4: docs        — NEWS, roxygen family, stale-vignette fixes, ADR status note
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Create `R/mock_spec_formula.R` helpers**

```r
# ==============================================================================
# Formula-derived variables (#39, Phase A) — spec-side helpers.
# Evaluation itself lives in evaluate_mock_formulas() (same file, Task 2).
# ADR: development/adr/v05-formula-evaluator.md
# ==============================================================================

# Base functions/operators a mockFormula may call. Deliberately closed and
# RNG-free: Phase A formulas are deterministic transformations of generated
# columns. Widen only on concrete need (ADR D3).
.formula_allowlist <- c(
  "+", "-", "*", "/", "^", "%%", "%/%", "(",
  "<", "<=", ">", ">=", "==", "!=", "&", "|", "!",
  "ifelse", "pmin", "pmax", "min", "max", "abs", "round", "floor",
  "ceiling", "sqrt", "exp", "log", "log10", "sum", "mean", "cut",
  "as.numeric", "as.integer", "as.factor", "factor", "c"
)

#' @noRd
.parse_mock_formula <- function(variable) {
  tryCatch(
    str2lang(variable$formula),
    error = function(e) {
      stop(
        "Formula for variable '", variable$name, "' could not be parsed: ",
        conditionMessage(e),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
}

#' @noRd
.is_formula_variable <- function(variable) {
  identical(variable$type, "formula")
}

#' @noRd
.formula_dependencies <- function(variable) {
  if (!.is_formula_variable(variable)) {
    return(character(0))
  }
  all.vars(.parse_mock_formula(variable))
}

#' @noRd
.formula_function_symbols <- function(variable) {
  expr <- .parse_mock_formula(variable)
  setdiff(all.names(expr), all.vars(expr))
}

#' @noRd
.validate_formula_referents <- function(spec) {
  spec_names <- names(spec$variables)
  for (variable in spec$variables) {
    if (!.is_formula_variable(variable)) next
    missing <- setdiff(.formula_dependencies(variable), spec_names)
    if (length(missing) > 0) {
      stop(
        "Formula for variable '", variable$name,
        "' references unknown variable(s): ",
        paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
    disallowed <- setdiff(.formula_function_symbols(variable), .formula_allowlist)
    if (length(disallowed) > 0) {
      stop(
        "Formula for variable '", variable$name,
        "' uses function(s) not permitted in mockFormula expressions: ",
        paste(disallowed, collapse = ", "),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

#' @noRd
.order_formula_variables <- function(spec) {
  formula_names <- names(spec$variables)[
    vapply(spec$variables, .is_formula_variable, logical(1))
  ]
  remaining <- formula_names
  ordered <- character(0)
  while (length(remaining) > 0) {
    progressed <- FALSE
    for (name in remaining) {
      deps <- intersect(.formula_dependencies(spec$variables[[name]]), formula_names)
      if (all(deps %in% ordered)) {
        ordered <- c(ordered, name)
        remaining <- setdiff(remaining, name)
        progressed <- TRUE
      }
    }
    if (!progressed) {
      stop(
        "Formula dependency cycle or unresolved ordering among: ",
        paste(remaining, collapse = ", "),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  ordered
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Constructors in `R/mock_spec.R`**

`mock_spec_formula()` (place after `mock_spec_date()`), populating the existing `formula`/`depends_on` fields via `.new_mock_spec_variable()`:

```r
#' Create a formula-derived variable specification
#'
#' `mock_spec_formula()` describes a variable computed from other generated
#' variables by evaluating an algebraic expression (a `mockFormula`), rather
#' than sampled from a distribution. Evaluation happens in a restricted
#' environment exposing only the generated columns and a fixed allow-list of
#' base functions; see [evaluate_mock_formulas()].
#'
#' @param name Variable name.
#' @param formula Character scalar. An algebraic expression over other
#'   variable names, e.g. `"weight / (height^2)"`.
#' @param rtype R output type for the computed column. Defaults to `"double"`.
#' @param missing_codes,missing_proportions,garbage_rules,provenance,model_hint
#'   As for other variable specifications; applied by post-processing.
#'
#' @return A `mock_spec_variable` object of type `"formula"`.
#' @family mock specification APIs
#' @seealso [mock_formula()], [evaluate_mock_formulas()]
#' @export
mock_spec_formula <- function(name,
                              formula,
                              rtype = "double",
                              missing_codes = numeric(0),
                              missing_proportions = numeric(0),
                              garbage_rules = list(),
                              provenance = "direct",
                              model_hint = "auto") {
  variable <- .new_mock_spec_variable(
    name = name,
    type = "formula",
    rtype = rtype,
    formula = formula,
    missing_codes = missing_codes,
    missing_proportions = missing_proportions,
    garbage_rules = garbage_rules,
    provenance = provenance,
    model_hint = model_hint
  )
  # Parse failures are reported by validate_mock_spec(), not the constructor,
  # matching the sibling constructors' defer-all-validation contract.
  # depends_on is computed once here at construction time; it is not
  # re-synced if `formula` is mutated afterwards.
  variable$depends_on <- tryCatch(
    .formula_dependencies(variable),
    error = function(e) character(0)
  )
  variable
}
```

`mock_formula()` (simple direct API, mirroring `mock_continuous()`'s shape: wraps `mock_spec_formula()` in `mock_spec(...)` with `.direct_api_provenance("mock_formula", provenance)`). Follow the `mock_continuous()` pattern at `R/mock_spec.R:287` exactly, forwarding the same parameters.

- [ ] **Step 4: The evaluator** (append to `R/mock_spec_formula.R`)

```r
#' @noRd
.formula_parent_env <- function() {
  env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  for (fn in .formula_allowlist) {
    env[[fn]] <- get(fn, envir = baseNamespace())
  }
  env
}

#' Evaluate formula-derived variables over generated data
#'
#' Computes each `type = "formula"` variable in `spec` by evaluating its
#' expression over the columns of `data`, in dependency order. Evaluation runs
#' in a restricted environment exposing only the data columns and a fixed
#' allow-list of base functions — formulas cannot reach the caller's
#' environment. Any randomness would draw from the isolated `formula`
#' sub-stream (see the v0.5 seed contract), though the Phase A allow-list is
#' RNG-free, so evaluation is deterministic given `data`.
#'
#' @param data Data frame of generated baseline values (from
#'   [generate_mock_data_native()] or [generate_mock_data_simstudy()]).
#' @param spec A `mock_spec`. Non-formula variables must already be columns of
#'   `data`.
#' @param seed Optional whole-number seed; reserved for future formulas with
#'   random components. The caller's RNG state and kind are restored on exit.
#'
#' @return `data` with one appended column per formula variable. Returns
#'   `data` unchanged if the spec has no formula variables.
#' @seealso [mock_formula()], [postprocess_mock_data()]
#' @export
evaluate_mock_formulas <- function(data, spec, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.data.frame(data)) {
    stop("data must be a data frame.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  ordered <- .order_formula_variables(spec)
  if (length(ordered) == 0) {
    return(data)
  }
  .validate_formula_referents(spec)

  non_formula <- setdiff(names(spec$variables), names(spec$variables)[
    vapply(spec$variables, .is_formula_variable, logical(1))
  ])
  missing_inputs <- setdiff(non_formula, names(data))
  if (length(missing_inputs) > 0) {
    stop(
      "data is missing generated column(s) required by formulas: ",
      paste(missing_inputs, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  .with_mock_seed(seed, stage = "formula", {
    fn_env <- .formula_parent_env()
    for (name in ordered) {
      variable <- spec$variables[[name]]
      values <- eval(
        .parse_mock_formula(variable),
        envir = as.list(data),
        enclos = fn_env
      )
      if (length(values) == 1 && nrow(data) != 1) {
        values <- rep(values, nrow(data))   # scalar formulas broadcast
      }
      if (length(values) != nrow(data)) {
        stop(
          "Formula for variable '", name, "' returned length ", length(values),
          ", expected ", nrow(data), ".",
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
      data[[name]] <- .coerce_formula_rtype(values, variable$rtype, name)
    }
    data
  })
}

#' @noRd
.coerce_formula_rtype <- function(values, rtype, variable_name) {
  switch(rtype,
    double = ,
    numeric = as.numeric(values),
    integer = as.integer(values),
    factor = as.factor(values),
    character = as.character(values),
    logical = as.logical(values),
    stop(
      "Variable '", variable_name, "' has unsupported formula rType '",
      rtype, "'.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  )
}
```

Note on `envir = as.list(data)`: eval with a list envir + `enclos` gives column lookup first, then the allow-list env, whose parent is `emptyenv()` — nothing else is reachable. Verify with the sandbox tests; if `as.list()` + enclos misbehaves for `nrow(data) == 0` columns, use `list2env(as.list(data), parent = fn_env)` and drop `enclos` — either satisfies the tests; pick the one that passes and note which in the report.
